REFUSED_FABRICATED_FINALS.lesson: a plausibility check against START TIME is cheap and catches a class of fabrication that no amount of source-grading will. Proposed as a standing pre-admission gate: no result may be admitted, at ANY layer including display, for a game whose start time plus a sport-specific minimum duration is in the future.
